zh.summary: 没有代理也能更新：更新会跟随系统代理，GitHub 连不上时自动改用国内可用的镜像。
highlights: 检查更新、下载内核、安装插件会跟随 Windows 或 macOS 的系统代理，浏览器能上的地方它也能上。
GitHub 连不上时，会自动改用公共镜像下载。镜像只是备用线路：版本信息必须带有我们的签名才会采用，下载的安装包也会用签名信息里的校验值核对，镜像最坏只是连不上，改不了你装进去的内容。
发布流程现在会给更新信息签名；软件内置对应的公钥用来验证。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
想关闭镜像备用线路，可设置环境变量 DSH_PORTABLE_UPDATE_MIRRORS=off；也可以填成你自己的镜像地址（用逗号分隔）。
镜像服务能看到你下载了哪些更新文件，看不到你的会话和设置。

en.summary: Updates work without a proxy: they follow the system proxy and fall back to public mirrors when GitHub is unreachable.
highlights: Update checks, core downloads and plugin installs follow the Windows or macOS system proxy, so they work wherever your browser does.

When GitHub cannot be reached, downloads fall back to public mirrors. Mirrors are only a backup route: version information is accepted only with our signature, and downloaded packages are checked against the digest in that signed information, so a mirror can at worst fail, never change what you install.
Releases now sign the update information, and the application carries the matching public key to verify it.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
To turn the mirror fallback off, set the environment variable DSH_PORTABLE_UPDATE_MIRRORS=off; you can also set it to your own mirror addresses, comma-separated.
A mirror can see which update files you download, not your sessions or settings.
